_comment: Real photos shown in the designer for each apron style, taken from that apron's Ecwid listing (photo number = its position in the listing, from 0). After editing, run `npm run images` then `npm run build`.

bbq.about: An adjustable leather beer holder keeps your drink to hand while you cook, with tool loops, a pocket and adjustable straps for a secure fit. Made to measure, with full personalisation.
photos: Man wearing a tan BBQ apron engraved PAUL SMITH, with a bottle in the beer holder
Tan BBQ apron engraved with the Grill Master design and the 'If you can read this, get me a beer' circle
Close-up of the leather beer holder holding a bottle
Close-up of the tan pocket and beer holder on a black apron
Back view showing the crossed leather straps
Dark brown BBQ apron with a stag logo engraved on the chest
Black BBQ apron engraved FBS
Tan BBQ apron laid flat, showing the pocket, tool loops and beer holder

bbq-patterned.about: The beer-holder BBQ apron made from a patchwork of leather panels, so every apron has its own pattern of tones. Tool loops, a pocket and adjustable straps. Made to measure, with full personalisation.
photos: Patterned BBQ apron made of tan leather panels, with a logo engraved on the chest and a bottle in the beer holder
Man wearing a patterned tan leather BBQ apron, with a bottle in the beer holder
Patterned tan leather BBQ apron worn, showing the stitched panels and the pocket
